overview: FAREPULSE is a premium, demo-data airfare price index dashboard for Smart India Hackathon 2026 that turns permissioned airline/OTA fare observations into a transparent Base-100 Airfare Price Index for India.
features: Interactive live airfare index charts with time filters
Route explorer with fare analysis and booking-window insights
Airline analytics comparison across Indian carriers
Animated India airfare map with airport nodes and flight routes
Analytics dashboard with sidebar and observations table
Data quality donut charts and clickable fare alerts
Methodology, feasibility, impact and API documentation pages
